relationships.history: She placed three engineers at Parallax Labs. He hired a fourth she'd lined up for someone else, and still thinks he did her a favour.
Met at a gala Aaliyah produced in Atlanta six years ago. Aaliyah is the reason Dominique said yes to Livéra.
Meridian fills executive roles for Whitaker Capital's portfolio companies. He's her biggest client in town.
Leila keeps asking who's being hired where. Dominique keeps not answering.
Dominique sees Harper every Thursday at 7 a.m., before anyone else is awake. Nobody knows.

memories.info: Dax hired a candidate she was placing elsewhere, without telling her.
Accepted Meridian's offer to open the Livéra office. Left Atlanta in a week.
Aaliyah flew to Atlanta to help her pack.
Grandma Inez put the gold coin pendant around her neck the morning she left for Spelman: 'So you remember who sent you.'
At 19, matched a classmate with her first internship from the career-center front desk. Found out she was good at this.
At 24, placed a nurse who'd been turned down thirty times. Bought her first blazer with the commission.

profile.tagline: Came to staff a city. Plans to own part of it.

appearance.face: soft oval face, full brows, full lips, a steady gaze and a slight closed-mouth smile
appearance.hair: long, voluminous jet-black body waves with a centre part
appearance.style: black double-breasted blazer with gold buttons, blush-pink wrap blouse, black high-waisted wide-leg trousers, black belt with a gold buckle, black patent pointed pumps, burgundy structured top-handle bag with gold hardware
appearance.jewelry: her grandmother's gold coin pendant (never off), gold watch, small gold hoops
appearance.silhouette: sharp-shouldered blazer over a defined waist; wide-leg trousers to the floor

outfits.work: black double-breasted blazer, blush-pink wrap blouse, black wide-leg trousers, black patent pumps, burgundy top-handle bag
outfits.weekend: camel coat over the shoulders, cream ribbed knit, taupe wide-leg trousers, nude pointed heels, cognac top-handle bag

key_features: Long jet-black hair: straight at 19, a messy bun at 24, full body waves now
Her grandmother's gold coin pendant, at every age
Soft oval face and full lips
Wide-leg trousers, always; a power palette of black, blush and burgundy

profile.family_background: Eldest of three, raised in Decatur, Georgia by a mother who ran a hair salon and a father who drove for MARTA. Her grandmother Inez gave her the gold coin pendant the morning she left for Spelman. Sends money home monthly.
goals: Make Recruiting Manager within a year
Build a circle in a town where she knows almost nobody
ambitions: Run the largest staffing firm in Livéra
Own a building on Founders Way
profile.social_preferences: Prefers small dinners to big crowds; warms up slowly, then all the way.

secrets.truth: Her old Atlanta firm has a standing offer for her to come back as a partner. She hasn't said no.
She sees Harper James for therapy every Thursday morning.

weekdays.activity: Gym or a run in Founders Park
Home, or networking at Heritage Coffee

social_media.bio: Talent. Taste. Timing. New to Livéra.

life_history: 19: work-study at the Spelman career center; placed her first classmate in an internship.
22: graduated from Spelman and took a job nobody else wanted, recruiting night-shift nurses.
24: top biller on her team; bought her first work wardrobe with her first commission.
27: moved to Meridian Talent; top-billing recruiter in Atlanta two years running.
28: ended a four-year relationship the month before moving.
29: first of the founding residents to sign a lease at The Lexington.

life_stages.chapter: Sophomore at Spelman, working the front desk of the campus career center for work-study. Matched a classmate with her first internship and realised she was good at it.

look.carrying: monogram backpack, an armful of notebooks

life_stages.chapter: Recruiter at a healthcare staffing firm in Atlanta: sixty-hour weeks, nurses and night shifts. Bought her first real work clothes with her first commission check.
